intro: I'm Ravi Kumar, a Backend Developer with 2+ years of experience building production-ready backend applications, REST APIs and business solutions.
My work spans a PHP (Slim) CRM/ERP backend used daily in production, Laravel APIs, database optimisation, third-party integrations, and containerised deployments on AWS.
I focus on maintainable code, measurable performance improvements, reliable database workflows, and clean integrations with external services.

approachSubtitle: What I do day to day at work, and what my JobBoard API project adds.

principles.title: Transaction-safe business logic
principles.detail: Payment allocation runs inside MySQL transactions with row locks (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), so concurrent requests can't allocate the same receipt twice.

principles.title: Query performance
principles.detail: Find the slow endpoints, replace N+1 loops with window-function queries, and cache hot reads in Redis.

principles.title: Webhook integrations
principles.detail: Webhook handlers and API clients that bring Meta Lead Ads, Google APIs, Microsoft Graph and Exotel events into CRM workflows.

principles.title: Access control and audit trails
principles.detail: Role-based access checks on workflow modules, with status tracking and audit logs for changes.

principles.title: Layered API structure
principles.detail: Controllers, route middleware for auth and roles, Eloquent models, and rate limits on public routes.

principles.title: Tested, automated delivery
principles.detail: PHPUnit tests run in GitHub Actions against MySQL and Redis on every push; passing builds deploy to EC2.
